class.name: SteamPublisherHost
class.brief_description: Resolves secrets and owns the trusted publisher transport.
class.description: Attach a subclass on the trusted backend and override [method _resolve_secret]. Production requests use verified HTTPS to the fixed Steam partner origin. Test builds replace the transport with a local override and open no sockets.

method.name: _fixture_transport_enabled
method.description: Returns true in publisher test builds. This fixture method is omitted from production builds.

method.name: _resolve_secret
method.description: Returns the secret for the configured reference or an empty string when unavailable. Keep returned data inside the trusted host.

method.name: _resolve_encrypted_ticket_key
method.description: Returns the exact private Steam app-ticket decryption key bytes for [param reference], or an empty array if unavailable. Resolve this key only inside the trusted backend.

method.name: _test_decrypted_ownership_ticket
method.description: Returns synthetic decrypted ticket claims for encrypted ownership fixtures. This override is available only in the publisher test build.

method.name: _test_response
method.description: Returns synthetic [code]status[/code], [code]body[/code] bytes, and optional [code]ticks[/code] in a publisher test build. The hook receives whether a key was resolved and never receives the key value.
